idea.title: Baliza a pe na autoescola
idea.text: Trend do passo duro (fonte do Caio, estúdio de dança) virando prova de baliza a pé num pátio de autoescola; no fim o examinador põe um cone no topete.

script.title: Baliza a pe na autoescola
script.premise: Gersinho faz a prova de baliza da autoescola a pé, com o passo duro da trend, entre os cones do pátio, sério; no fim o examinador põe um cone no topete dele.
script.gag_without_sound: um tiozão brega de topete gigante fazendo a baliza a pé, duro como poste, e virando ele mesmo o cone

trend.name: passo duro (estilo dança irlandesa), vídeo enviado pelo Caio em 06/10
trend.source_hint: recorte 0,8-6,4 s do vídeo do Caio: 1 pessoa, corpo inteiro, mãos visíveis, plano contínuo; câmera acompanha de leve
trend.consent: PENDENTE: vídeo enviado pelo Caio; confirmar quem filmou e ter autorização por escrito do dançarino antes de postar (videos-analisados §12)

music.trend_sound_hint: som em alta de passinho duro no app

script.caption: Reprovado de novo. Mas com estilo.
script.risks: a câmera da fonte acompanha de leve; o topete balançar nos pulinhos; identidade derreter quando ele se aproxima da câmera

en.location: a Brazilian driving-school practice lot: grey asphalt with faded white parking-test lines, a row of orange traffic cones marking the parallel-parking box, a white compact hatchback with a 'AUTOESCOLA' roof sign parked at frame-left, a low painted wall and a mango tree in the background
en.lighting: Bright mid-morning sun from frame-right, hard shadows, 5600K.
en.extras_tasks: one instructor in a beige polo writes on a clipboard beside the hatchback at frame-left, one student waits sitting on the low wall in the background looking at her phone
en.replace_subject: the man in the blue striped shirt walking toward the camera
en.source_expression: the source dancer is deadpan: lips closed, lip corners level, brows level, eyes ahead; the source audio is muted

stages.text: He finishes the last step between the two front cones, stops with both feet together and rests his right hand on his belly, chin raised, staring into the lens.
stages.end_state: standing still between the two front cones, hand on belly, chin raised, eyes on the lens
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

stages.text: The instructor's arm in a beige polo sleeve enters from the frame-left edge and sets one orange traffic cone upright on top of his rigid pompadour, then withdraws; he holds the same pose and keeps staring into the lens.
stages.facing: chest 0° to the lens, face 0° to the lens, eyes on the lens

counterpart.who: the driving instructor in a beige polo
counterpart.position: off-screen beyond the frame-left edge; only his right forearm and hand enter the frame
counterpart.limb: right forearm and hand in a beige polo sleeve
counterpart.vector: the right hand travels screen-left to screen-right and stops on top of his pompadour, then returns screen-right to screen-left out of the frame

stages.end_state: one orange traffic cone stands upright on top of his rigid pompadour; he stares deadpan into the lens

en.end_change: one orange traffic cone standing upright on top of his rigid pompadour while he stares deadpan into the lens
en.gag_sentence: After the steps he stops between the cones and the instructor's arm sets an orange traffic cone on top of his rigid pompadour.
